title: Design a High-Volume Financial Auditing Ledger
subtitle: Hot LSM MemTable/SSTable ingestion -> Cold compressed Parquet columnar audit tier
functionalReqs: Record immutable cryptographically linked financial entries (`150k/s` baseline, `400k/s` burst) with monotonic account sequence numbers.
Reconstruct exact account state at any historical timestamp `T` in `< 25 ms` without scanning years of logs.
Run multi-billion-row regulatory quarterly audit range aggregations in `< 2 s` without slowing live writes.

nonFunctionalReqs.rationale: Sequential LSM WAL + MemTable avoids 4KB B-Tree random-write page splits.
Cold Dictionary/RLE-encoded Parquet cuts bytes scanned by >90%.
Every committed audit tuple must survive whole-AZ failures.

workedSummary.dailyRawIngest: 150,000/s × 86,400 × 350 B = 4.53 TB/day raw (220 TB cold compressed over 5y)
workedSummary.bloomFilterRam: 64 Hot LSM shards -> ~96 GB cluster RAM keeps absent-key disk seeks near zero
workedSummary.columnarScanSavings: Dictionary + RLE encoding skips 88–92% of I/O for quarterly 3-column audits

apiContracts.purpose: Append immutable audited ledger tuple into hot Raft-replicated LSM shard with hash chain check

explorerTopology.title: Hot LSM Write Shards -> Cold Columnar Audit Engine
explorerTopology.subtitle: Sequential WAL + MemTable -> Bloom-Indexed SSTables -> Parquet Compactor
explorerTopology.overview: Why financial auditing systems split workloads across write-optimized LSM engines (hot 7 days) and Dictionary/RLE compressed columnar stores (5-year audit scans).
keyTakeaways: Sequential LSM writes eliminate B-Tree 4KB random-page write amplification.
Checkpoint snapshots every 1,000 rows guarantee bounded O(1,000) point-in-time balance reconstruction.

nodes.label: Ledger Writers
nodes.summary: Receives verified settlement entries and routes cleanly by account hash.
failureModes: Unordered concurrent timestamps corrupt point-in-time ordering without monotonic seq

nodes.label: Hot LSM Shards (7d)
nodes.summary: Buffers writes in SkipList MemTable + append-only quorum WAL; Bloom filters skip nonexistent SSTable disk reads.
failureModes: Unthrottled L0 SSTable bursts trigger write stalls unless compaction bandwidth is reserved

nodes.label: Flink Columnar Compactor
nodes.summary: Reads immutable flushed SSTables older than 7 days and encodes sorted columnar Parquet stripes.
failureModes: Non-idempotent jobs duplicate rows into S3 archives

nodes.label: Cold Parquet + Iceberg
nodes.summary: Stores 10x compressed columnar audit records with min/max zone-map statistics.
failureModes: Thousands of tiny files hurt metadata scans without target 256MB stripe compaction

nodes.label: Vectorized Audit Query
nodes.summary: Scans only audited columns cleanly via SIMD CPU execution + checkpoint balance anchors.
failureModes: Running analytics directly on live OLTP B-Trees degrades active payment writes

chaosScenarios.title: 400k/s Write Burst L0 Compaction Stall
chaosScenarios.triggerSummary: Market close floods 400k/s entries; unmerged L0 SSTables spike, threatening compaction write stalls & read amplification.
chaosScenarios.mitigationSummary: Dedicated NVMe compaction rate-limiter reserves 35% disk IOPS while Bloom filters in RAM shield recent reads from touching disk.

steps.info: Reserves 35% NVMe write bandwidth exclusively for L0->L1 compaction; 10-bit Bloom filters drop 99% of unnecessary L0 seeks.
steps.payloadInspector:
l0_files: 14 -> capped cleanly
Bloom Reject Rate: 99.1% (RAM only)
steps.inspectorNote: Prevents catastrophic write-stall cascading pauses during market spikes.

pros: Optimal sequential write speed + 10x cheaper compressed audit storage
Zero analytical interference with transactional writes
cons: Requires two query/merge layers and deterministic compaction job

deepDives.title: Mitigating LSM Write Stalls & SSD Wear Amplification
deepDives.bottleneck: Leveled compaction multiplies disk writes 10–30x; unpaced compactions choke live MemTable flushes.
deepDives.solution: Use Size-Tiered L0/L1 intake paired with reserved NVMe I/O rate limits and large batch WAL group commits.
deepDives.tradeoff: Higher transient space usage (20%) prevents hard latency stalls during 400k/s bursts.

deepDives.title: O(1000) Point-in-Time Reconstruction Without Full Log Replay
deepDives.bottleneck: Scanning millions of delta records to verify one account's historical balance breaks `<25ms` SLA.
deepDives.solution: Emit immutable `balance_checkpoint` records every 1,000 events and index them cleanly in Parquet/SSTable.
deepDives.tradeoff: <0.2% storage overhead eliminates variable linear log replays permanently.

criteria: Quantifies B-Tree random-page write amplification vs LSM MemTable/WAL sequential writes
Sizes Bloom filter RAM (~10 bits/key) and handles leveled compaction stalls & write amplification
Transforms flushed immutable data into Dictionary/RLE-compressed Parquet for sub-2s range audits
Adds periodic checkpoint snapshots for bounded O(1000) historical state reconstruction
